A '''village''' was located on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], near the [[Jedi Enclave]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], a [[Dantooine rebels|group]] of people on Dantooine harbored the fugitive Jedi [[Falon Grey]] there. The village was eventually [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
